The mechanical validate-completion gate returns DENIED for a reason OUTSIDE this change's control: _changed_files() scopes to the entire `git status --porcelain`, so it counts 132 undeclared governed paths that belong to pre-existing working-tree modifications and to concurrently-running sessions (this repo routinely runs many Claude sessions at once; two docs/implementation_plan/*.md files were observed changing during this session's window and were deliberately left alone). Those files were NOT added to declared_files: declaring paths this change never touched would launder another session's work through this manifest and defeat the gate's purpose. The 18 declared files were verified by modification time against this session's working window. Resolving this needs either a clean tree or a validator scoped to a declared path set — a governance decision, not a code change.
